_comment: His entries are short and few on purpose. He is not introspective, he writes three
lines when he writes at all, and the result is an account where almost everything is
Unknown — not because he is hiding anything but because he has not examined it. A
thin record should produce thin conclusions, and his is the clean case of that.
He is also the other half of Vanessa's expectations question. She cannot tell whether
he has changed his mind; his own account shows that he has, roughly, and has not said
so — partly because he has not fully worked it out himself. Neither account can see
the other, and the product never reconciles them.
Catherine ended things with him over conversation. His version is that it was fine and
then it stopped, which is its own kind of evidence about how much he was tracking.

entries.body:
Asked Vanessa if she wanted to do something Sunday. Actual daytime thing, not the usual.

She said maybe. Hard to tell with her.

I think I would be fine if this turned into something. I had not really planned on it. She said at the beginning she did not want a boyfriend and I said no problem, which was true at the time. I have not brought it up since because it would be a whole thing and we are good as we are.

She is the most alive person I know. That is the thing I keep thinking about.
